live_repo_warning: The exact live GitHub repository state was not directly read in this audit. Findings compare the distributed full-build lineage and the user's live observations. Items labeled NEEDS LIVE VERIFY require final visual/runtime confirmation.

findings.canonical_requirement: The package must contain every local file its Vercel routes reference.
findings.observed: `vercel.json` routes `/app` to `/home.html`, but the full package is missing: home.html, master-app.js, master-app.css.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Restore the approved master shell (`home.html`, `master-app.js`, `master-app.css`) into the single consolidated release, then version it with the current auth/branding rules.

findings.canonical_requirement: Do not mix new HTML with leftover older repository JS/CSS.
findings.observed: Because `/home.html` and master-app assets are missing from the replacement package, Vercel/GitHub can continue serving older repository copies while Recovery uses newer files.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Ship one complete replacement set and remove dependency on leftover repository files.

findings.canonical_requirement: One coherent login experience; returning Recovery should not encounter two independent auth boots.
findings.observed: Recovery has its optimized auth owner, while the older master shell still contains its own `signInWithPassword`, `getSession`, and blocking `Promise.all(loadProfile/loadTopics/loadEnrollments)` flow.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Unify the master shell with the current authenticated session contract; do not make the master shell re-authenticate or block on its own boot.

findings.canonical_requirement: Recovery auth should enter the shell immediately and hydrate secondary data in background.
findings.observed: Current Recovery file has one `signInWithPassword`, one `getSession`, no `onAuthStateChange`, and background hydration behavior. The stale master shell can still block on three loads.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Preserve Recovery fast-auth behavior and bring the master shell onto the same session contract.

findings.canonical_requirement: Completed onboarding/interview must not restart for an existing Recovery profile.
findings.observed: Current Recovery contains both `onboardingOverlay` (1) and `finalOnboardingOverlay` (1); it calls FinalOnboarding.check 60ms after shell entry.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Resolve existing profile/onboarding state before deciding to open onboarding, and skip all intro/interview overlays for a configured returning user.

findings.canonical_requirement: Returning Recovery path should be sign in -> last Recovery page or Today; My Journeys is optional.
findings.observed: Live behavior reported by user required Welcome -> View My Journeys -> Continue Recovery, and first attempt restarted interview.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Make Recovery the direct continuation for an enrolled returning Recovery user; keep Home/My Journeys accessible but not mandatory.

findings.canonical_requirement: Start Your Journey should begin the interview once and then proceed into the selected journey.
findings.observed: User reported Start Your Journey returned to the landing page.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Keep tabled until the consolidated correction, then fix routing after the approval ledger is applied.

findings.canonical_requirement: Public pages use master Lellee artwork; Recovery-specific dark mark stays inside Recovery.
findings.observed: The full master-logo build over-applied a Recovery-specific asset; later Public Visual Restore corrected public `index.html`/`landing.html` to approved public artwork.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Consolidate the corrected public asset split into the final release rather than relying on layered patches.
findings.evidence: Master Logo Lock + Public Visual Restore lineage

findings.canonical_requirement: Logo must be prominent and tagline legible but contained fully inside header.
findings.observed: Earlier exact proportional CSS used transform scaling and later bled into the hero; latest alignment patch removed transform bleed but has not been explicitly user-approved in live view.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Use real container sizing, no overflow bleed, and verify visually at desktop/tablet/mobile before release.
findings.evidence: Exact Proportional -> Card Height Balance -> latest user correction

findings.canonical_requirement: Hero card and Your Lellee Journey tile align cleanly in the approved hierarchy.
findings.observed: User reported live misalignment after prior proportional restore. Latest alignment CSS is distributed but not user-confirmed.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Verify and lock final top/bottom alignment after applying the canonical visual hierarchy.

findings.canonical_requirement: Master app shell should not be held stale after replacement.
findings.observed: Current `vercel.json` does not include a specific `/home.html` no-cache/no-store header: False.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Add explicit no-cache/no-store for `/home.html` and `/app` in the consolidated deploy.

findings.observed: Current full package contains all latest price markers: {'$5.99': True, '$59.99': True, '$14.99': True, '$149': True, '$4.99': True, '$49.99': True, '$19.99': True}; stale $3.99/$39.99 scan: none.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Preserve exact pricing; do not reintroduce old Stripe sandbox amounts.

findings.canonical_requirement: Account/client count hidden by default with On/Off switch.
findings.observed: `recovery.html` includes the Show account count control and Off-by-default wording; latest visibility implementation was designed to start hidden per session.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Preserve; verify in production coach dashboard.
findings.evidence: Current recovery.html / Coach Account Visibility lineage

findings.canonical_requirement: R3–R13 access control, permissions, consent, user control center, and admin operations remain present.
findings.observed: Required latest agent control files present: {'lellee-agent-access-control.js': True, 'lellee-agent-permissions.js': True, 'lellee-agent-control-center.js': True, 'lellee-admin-agent-operations.js': True, 'lellee-coaching-message-consent.js': True}.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Preserve and verify production DB/functions/kill switches separately.

findings.canonical_requirement: Latest architecture names Viral, Social, Marketing/Growth, Prospecting, Analytics/Optimization distinctly.
findings.observed: The architecture is approved, but not every named growth role has been verified as a distinct production agent in the current package/database.
findings.required_consolidated_action: During consolidated correction, preserve existing agent security and verify which named roles are actually instantiated before claiming them live.
findings.evidence: Prior conversation architecture + current agent files

findings.canonical_requirement: Paid plans may only be treated live after production Stripe/webhook/entitlement verification.
findings.observed: Pricing/checkout code exists, but prior QA/cutover gates require final production verification.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Run Stripe production gate after UI/auth regression correction; do not infer readiness from UI alone.

findings.canonical_requirement: AI crawler blocking must be enforced at edge/WAF, not robots alone.
findings.observed: Architecture and documentation are present; actual production edge configuration has not been verified in this audit.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Verify Cloudflare/WAF/edge controls at go-live gate.

findings.canonical_requirement: Qualified legal/privacy/clinical review remains a production gate.
findings.observed: Build includes legal/privacy/safety notices, but that does not certify compliance.
findings.required_consolidated_action: Complete review before public production launch.
